scope: canceled/suspended emergency food distributions from storm/flood/fire/outage/facility damage
abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.result: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified inside the bounded hourly window.
notable_exclusions: Kaua'i County hurricane recovery notice listed emergency food distributions proceeding as scheduled; no cancellation or suspension.
Beaumont, Texas neighborhood grocery closure was published five days earlier and was outside the hourly window.
Spencer, New York only-grocery-store fire occurred September 11 and was outside the hourly window.
Pottstown, Pennsylvania pantry building fire was older and services continued next door without an access interruption.
Smooth Rock Falls pantry closure was in Ontario, Canada, and outside U.S. scope.
